notes.title: clickyland v1.0.2
notes.content:
Hello! Here are a few QoL and balancing changes, as well as some small bugfixes.

[u][b]Fixes[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Moving mouse while rapid clicking should no longer cause other things to be clicked
[*] Fixed bug with tar not clearing when right clicking
[*] Improved fog clearing performance
[*] Fixed bug with explosion sometimes causing a crash when there's too many at the same time
[/list]
[u][b]Quality of Life[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] You can now hold shift to place multiple buildings
[*] Spacebar no longer causes next day to start
[*] Holding shift while bulldozing now keeps you in bulldoze mode
[/list]
[u][b]Balancing[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Increased duration coins stay on ground
[*] Buffed barracks
[*] Made freeze tower 3x3 again
[*] Increased landmine explosion radius
[*] Click storage now gets more expensive the more you have of them
[*] Buffed snowman
[*] Buffed witch
[*] Buffed wuppie
[*] Buffed polar bear
[*] Increased damage done by fire to buildings
[*] Illegal logger now attacks your lumber camps
[*] Increased the amount of diamonds in a diamond deposit from 5 to 10
[/list]

- Aran

notes.title: clickyland v1.0.1
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Thanks for playing clickyland. Here's the first patch that should fix some of the issues people are having:

[list]
[*] Buffed freeze tower
[*] Fixed resource texts in the top left not being translated when changing languages
[*] Fixed a bug where destroying all spawners would cause enemies to spawn in your castle
[*] Fixed issues with font rendering in simplified and traditional chinese
[*] Fixed a bug with UI scaling in ultrawide resolutions
[*] Fixed miscellaneous bugs and crashes
[/list]

- Aran from Sokpop
